reviewer: independent child agent, read-only source and saved-artifact contract audit

caughtAndFixed.finding: Cancellation during asynchronous pre-publication verification could still copy the target revision file before checking the abort signal. SQL did not falsely complete, but a late owned-file write was possible.
caughtAndFixed.resolution: Abort is now checked immediately after verification and after reading the accepted PDF, before writeExact(targetRevision).
caughtAndFixed.verified: Current frozen source re-read; owner supplies gated cancellation regression separately.

caughtAndFixed.finding: New create/Apply route locks synchronously kicked the goal worker, whose same-document lock initially had no signal and threw This item is busy before the route released ownership.
caughtAndFixed.resolution: Registered document execution now passes its goal AbortSignal to shared exclusive(), waiting for the route lock to release while preserving Stop behavior.
caughtAndFixed.verified: Current frozen source re-read and all registered mutation lock call paths inspected; owner supplies wakeup/native-route checks separately.

checkedContracts: A child of an accepted current edit pins base revision, operation, PDF/HTML/provenance hashes, accepted parent goal-body hash, base state/input hashes and complete before draft. Every retry/export recursively verifies the pinned original and accepted ancestors, bounded to32revisions with cycle checks.

Historical registrations require current revision at least their own revision, not equality, so accepted version1 exports remain verifiable after version2 becomes current. Exact revision files and labels remain pinned.

An independent invocation of the real current private plan() over actual accepted1087version1 state/provenance reproduces its HTML and provenance JSON byte-for-byte, without opening a database, constructing a store, starting a service or invoking a model.

Current-summary raw text/citations is wrapped into the paragraph structure unchanged. Host comparison formatting and literal single-sentence/shorter/location checks do not compose the factual rewrite.

The measured DOCUMENT_REWRITE_PROFILE is frozen, host-selected, pinned before inference and compared against the saved current-version request. Production routes explicitly supply documentRewriteInfer only for current-summary mode; old grounded writers, support review and ordinary inference retain infer/T0.

The document profile requests temperature0.7,top_p0.8,top_k20,min_p0,seed42,chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false on the same loopback model transport. Scheduler preemption preserves the profile/request; cancellation/provider failure does not silently fall back to default decoding. This is request-routing evidence, not a fresh native-quality pass.

All registered PDF mutations share the document-id ownership lock: native edit execution, create/Apply base preparation, HTTPedit/restore, foreground pdfTools outerlock and goal executor. Conditional SQL publication, operation-owned files and writeExact collision guards prevent overwriting another accepted revision.

Approve re-reads current goal after asynchronous original/base verification, rejects cancelled/conflicting bases and binds the exact operation/proposal hash. Continue/startup do not approve a proposal; uncertain delivery retains GET inspection rather than replay.

The native review dialog is a showModal surface with a960pxmaximum/stacked narrow layout, fixed Apply/Cancel footer, explicit base/result versions and summary section, focus heading/restoration, native Escape cancellation and a page-global shortcut guard. Opening/closing review performs no mutation.

Review rendering uses inert React text/code and allowed HTTPS links derived only from retained quotation URLs; raw before/proposed/native data and exact citation evidence remain separately inspectable. Contextual base-version downloads and original-version downloads target their respective saved goals.

historicalPlanReadOnlyCheck.scope: Invoked the real current private plan() method over saved old provenance/state without constructing a store, opening any database, starting a service or requesting inference.

ownerValidationReportedSeparately.affectedChecks: 70tests/1144assertions before the one-argument lock wait fix; focused storage checks and both TypeScript targets after the fix, per root owner.
ownerValidationReportedSeparately.genuineCurrentVersionUi: Pending; prompt-only native success and injected transport/UI checks are not relabelled as end-to-end acceptance.

limits: Source/dialog contract audit and saved historical rendering reproduction only. This reviewer made no source edits, model calls, database writes, service starts, normal-data changes or build/test-gate runs.
Fresh native version1→2 output, actual browser restart/uncertain delivery and original desktop/narrow review screenshots remain required owner acceptance.
A measured writer-only decoding profile does not prove general semantic accuracy or arbitrary imported-PDF editing. Literal shape/location checks and the same-model support role have separate limits.
Physical handset/keyboard, native Windows/macOS, voice, public deployment and environment publication are outside this review.
